title: The Vanilla Pillager
description: Improved sounds, buildings, generation, raids, dungeons, and more
body:
##
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/323b93c3607b3738748e55f328f63f89c1b08206.png)
## Summary
>  I created this mod pack for myself.
>  I improved everything I could + it is possible to play on a weak device as I optimized it for them.
 
##

## Changes
> 💥 Improved sounds, buildings, generation, raids, dungeons, and more 💥
> 
> ✨ The modpack does not change the original style of Minecraft, but tries to complement and sometimes improve it. ✨
> 
> 🪓 Robber raids and outposts have been improved. Now they have become more dangerous and more complex. Other structures have also been improved. 🏹
> 
> 🌲 Many beautiful biomes have been added and the old ones and their generation have been improved. 🌍
> 
> 🗡️ A small arsenal update has also been added. In the form of a katana, an axe, a two-handed sword, and more. ⚔️
> 
> 🩸 Weather effects and other things were improved... He also added the ability to temporarily leave bodies after killing a mob. also, after receiving damage, blood will flow and there will be effects on the screen. 🩸
##
